comparison.rationale: A compatibility regression for one exact compiled FlyBody/FlyGym/MuJoCo stack, beat-wrapped analytic fallback, advance-then-hold 0.2 ms controller clock, and collision-disabled fluid proxies. Numeric tolerances cover deterministic platform floating-point variation; this is not stable-flight, released-policy, muscle-calibration, or biological acceptance.

summary.authority_notice: This compatibility smoke proves that the pinned FlyBody worker executes. The analytic wingbeat is upstream's fallback formula, not the released learned straight-flight/saccade policy and not a validated neuromuscular result.
summary.body_state_reference: FlyBody free-joint root/thorax frame; not whole-fly centre of mass
summary.root_fluid_force_sample_semantics: sample i>=1 is the MuJoCo force applied over interval [time_s[i-1], time_s[i]]; integrate with dt*sum(samples[1:])
summary.waveform_semantics: continuous beat-local approximation of upstream fallback lookup table; not measured WPG
